name: V Starter Deck ชาเลนจ์

era.name: ซอร์ด แอนด์ ชีลด์

description.text: V Starter Deck: Challenge, a random ready-to-play 60-card deck with damage counters and a rule book: each holds one Pokémon V, and with luck a Pokémon VMAX as well, the first starter decks to offer one. Its Single Strike and Rapid Strike Urshifu V differ from the expansions' cards. This set holds every card the decks could contain.
